Definition: properly, to entwine as a screen; by implication, to fence in, cover over, (figuratively) protect
BiblicalUsage: 1) (Qal) to hedge, fence about, shut in; 2) to block, overshadow, screen, stop the approach, shut off, cover; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to screen, cover; 2a2) to cover oneself; 2a3) protector (participle); 2b) (Hiphil); 2b1) to screen, cover; 2b2) to cover, defecate (euphemism); 3) (Qal) to cover, lay over; 4) to weave together; 4a) (Qal) to weave together; 4b) (Pilpel) to weave, weave together
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
